fusions.name: Bardiche Drop
fusions.desc: Brings a long-hafted blade down on an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away. It deals 16 slashing damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Headsman's Reach
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, from up to 3.5 tiles away. It deals 20 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Beard Hook
fusions.desc: Hooks a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Jab, Jab, Hew
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
